F11: F11v_stock_discrepanciesv{security_invoker=true} SELECT p.id AS product_id,    p.name AS product_name,    p.store_id,    s.name AS store_name,    p.stock_current AS current_stock,    COALESCE(sum(sm.quantity_change), 0::numeric) AS expected_stock,    p.stock_current - COALESCE(sum(sm.quantity_change), 0::numeric) AS discrepancy   FROM products p     LEFT JOIN stock_movements sm ON sm.product_id = p.id AND sm.store_id = p.store_id     LEFT JOIN stores s ON s.id = p.store_id  WHERE p.is_active = true AND has_store_access(p.store_id)  GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.store_id, s.name, p.stock_current HAVING abs(p.stock_current - COALESCE(sum(sm.quantity_change), 0::numeric)) > 0.001;
